question: The square of the length of a space diagonal of a closed cube is 2175 cm². What is the total surface area (in cm²) of the cube?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Square of the **space diagonal** of a cube = 3a².

**Total Surface Area** (TSA) of a cube = 6a².

Relation: TSA = 2 × (Square of **Space Diagonal**).

TSA = 2 × 2175 = 4350 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 4350 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Square of the length of the **space diagonal** = 2175 cm².

Formula used: **Space Diagonal** (d) = a√3 | **Total Surface Area** = 6a².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/671a6ab1dbb4c460569c48ad58990b6ff63813c3419c3db12a95f425d74359f4.png] 

⇒ d² = (a√3)² = 3a²

⇒ 3a² = 2175 cm²

⇒ a² = 2175 ÷ 3 = 725 cm²

⇒ **Total Surface Area** = 6a²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 6 × 725 = 4350 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4350 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Face Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the diagonal of any one face is given by a√2, where 'a' is the side of the cube.

Volume of a Cube

The total space occupied by the cube is Volume (V) = a³ cubic units.

Lateral Surface Area

The area of the four vertical faces of the cube is Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = 4a² sq. units.</p
